reference.title: Scenario 7 — Admonition between Bullet list
reference.shortdesc: Consider a bulleted list where the author has inserted an admonition between two bullet items

section.p: Consider a bulleted list where the author has inserted an admonition between two bullet items to call out a precaution or clarification relevant to the item just listed.

row.entry: [Heading 2]:Supported Deployment Models [List Bullet]:On-premises deployment [Warning style]:Requires dedicated IT staff to maintain hardware. [List Bullet]:Cloud deployment [List Bullet]:Hybrid deployment

entry.codeblock:
Supported Deployment Models
  • On-premises deployment

    Requires dedicated IT staff to maintain hardware.
  • Cloud deployment
  • Hybrid deployment

section.p: Result:The admonition is nested inside the preceding <li> as a <note> element, and the <ul> remains a single continuous list.
